## Notes

Keen Software House (Czech); alpha 2013-10-23 on Steam early access; full release 2019-02-28; Xbox One 2020, PS4/PS5 2023; VRAGE engine; editable voxel asteroids and planets; small and large grids; deformable armor blocks; conveyors; inertia dampeners; oxygen and energy survival; 5 million+ sold.
